attributes.description: towering, jagged mountain peak covered in snow, rugged, rocky face illuminated by warm golden light from the low sun, casting long shadows and highlighting the texture of the ice and stone

fast-flowing river or fjord current rushes past, captured with a long exposure that creates a silky, blurred effect in the water, contrasting with the sharp, frozen textures of the snow-covered rocks and banks
snow-covered rocks and banks with visible crystalline textures and subtle wind-swept patterns

row of traditional red wooden fishing cabins with white-trimmed windows and dark roofs, sitting on wooden stilts along the water’s edge, arranged in a gentle curve, each with snow on their roofs and surrounding ground, vivid red paint, some with small wooden railings and appear weathered but charming
snow blankets the ground and rocks, with visible crystalline textures and subtle wind-swept patterns
sky transitions from soft lavender and rose-pink near the horizon to a cooler, dusky purple higher up, indicating the golden hour
